rationale: Proposed protocol for the v2 weekly model wave (D-59, D-60; docs/MODEL_TESTING_V2_PROPOSAL.md; docs/model-eval/ARCHITECTURE_EVAL_V2.md WP-1). STATUS: PROPOSED, nothing here is ratified and no code reads this file yet; the planner that would read it is a later work package (WP-2). It supersedes weekly-v1 on paper only: no v1 wave exists (D-59), so no v1 wave is invalidated. Every field of weekly/PROTOCOL.json is carried with its v1 value unless a field's own rationale says otherwise. Values the founder must choose are written as blocks with open:true, an O-id (O1..O15), a proposed_default, the options and a source; the file cannot be ratified while any block is open (lib/protocol-v2.mjs). The proposed_requirements section lists things a v2 wave would need that are NOT implemented; each is a requirement to build, not a description of the harness. Changing this file after ratification is a versioned, founder-approved event: bump protocol_version, never edit a field in place for one week.

experiment_finding.finding: A fixed 0.759 would fire on sampling noise alone: under one pooled exact-agreement rate of 0.821 the lowest of 8 subjects falls at or below 0.759 in 22.9% of waves, and 5 of 8 per-subject item-clustered intervals contain 0.759.

anchor.rationale: Each wave has judges re-rate a seeded sample of stored pilot-2026-10-03 replies (6 per source subject) and reports the mean absolute difference from the original rating. The only observation so far is the pilot-2026-10-03 bridge against pilot-2026-10-02: mean 0.146, 41 of 48 rating pairs exact. The threshold 0.30 is about twice that observation, so ordinary session-to-session noise passes and a clear shift in judging is flagged. A wave whose mean absolute difference is above the threshold is marked 'not comparable'. It is a starting value and the founder may revise it only by a new protocol version, with the drift series available as evidence.

max_abs_signed_drift.source: No default. Observed per-judge signed drift -0.062..+0.214 rating units (pilot-2026-10-03/analysis.json:3109-3123). docs/model-eval/METHODS_LANDSCAPE.md suggested v2 additions.

experiment_finding.note: PROPOSAL ONLY (EVAL-PROTO-UPDATE, D-63 Stream B). Not ratified; the value stays OPEN for the founder.
experiment_finding.finding: No judge's signed bridge-drift interval excludes 0 in either bridge; pooled signed drift is +0.021 [-0.083, 0.125] (pilot-2) and +0.063 [-0.021, 0.188] (pilot-3). Day-to-day re-rate drift is about the size of same-day disagreement between judges.
experiment_finding.proposed_alternative: report-only in the first v2 wave (already an option). If a number is wanted: 0.20 rating units, calibrated on 2 bridges only.

max_mean_abs_difference_experiment_note.note: PROPOSAL ONLY (EVAL-PROTO-UPDATE, D-63 Stream B). Not ratified; the value stays OPEN for the founder. The value 0.30 above is unchanged and is the only one the planner reads.
max_mean_abs_difference_experiment_note.finding: 0.30 is too tight for a 48-pair bridge: the upper 95% bound of the pooled mean absolute difference is 0.375 in pilot-2 (observed 0.229) and 0.292 in pilot-3 (observed 0.146).

proposed_requirements.status_note: REQUIREMENTS ONLY. None of these is implemented; each is a thing the harness would have to gain before the stated condition. Do not cite any of them as a property of the current pipeline.

sensitivity_coverage.requirement: Every bank item carries a sensitivity classification (standard|high, with topics) assigned by a qualified human reviewer, and coverage is 100% before include_sensitive may be set true.

required_before_include_sensitive.purpose: A critical-harm breach is reported as its own rate and is not averaged into the composite.
Declines are recorded neutrally, each with a quote, reported apart from ratings. No rubric change.

hosted_record_status.requirement: The hosted subject record carries status in {refused, filtered} and a moderation field. Filter refusals are data and are never retried. The provider retention setting is declared for any high-sensitivity item.

weighted_agreement.requirement: A chance-corrected ordinal agreement statistic reported beside exact agreement.
weighted_agreement.variant: OPEN (undecided, methods reviewer): weighted kappa or Krippendorff's alpha; this is a requirement-level choice, not one of O1..O15

item_clustered_intervals.requirement: Bootstrap intervals resample by item, with the numbers of items and clusters published beside any range.

experiment_finding.note: PROPOSAL ONLY (EVAL-PROTO-UPDATE, D-63 Stream B). Not ratified; the value stays OPEN for the founder.
experiment_finding.finding: Scorer trial-level intervals treat judge ratings as independent and are about 4 times too narrow (median width ratio 0.23 in pilot-3; 0.23 to 0.25 across pilot-1 to pilot-3 re-computed by lib/intervals.mjs).
experiment_finding.proposed_method: Never quote scorer trial-level intervals. Single subject: item-clustered percentile bootstrap (items resampled within dimension, all replies and judges of a drawn item kept). Paired difference: item-then-reply (items resampled within dimension, paired across subjects, then whole replies resampled). 1000 replicates, fixed seed, 95% percentile interval.
experiment_finding.analysis_module: research/model-runs/lib/intervals.mjs; bin/analyze-intervals.mjs writes INTERNAL analysis/<wave-id>/intervals.json; tests/intervals.test.mjs reproduces the experiment figures exactly.

judge_test_retest.requirement: Judges re-rate a seeded sample of their own earlier ratings; report exact-repeat rate and mean signed difference.
judge_test_retest.sample_size: OPEN (undecided, methods reviewer): suggested range 5 to 10 percent of rated replies; not one of O1..O15

signed_anchor_drift.requirement: The anchor check reports signed per-judge drift in addition to the mean absolute difference; threshold is O11.
